1531196.steps: 1) Go to Network/IPSec VPN/Rules and Settings, add a TI Manual Key VPN policy, SHA384 as IPSEC SA authentication algorithm. 2) On Peer FW, add the matched TI VPN policy. 3) Run VPN traffic. 4) Repeat steps 1-3 for SHA512 as IPSEC SA authentication algorithm. 5) Go to Network/IPSec VPN/Rules and Settings, add a TI Preshared VPN policy, Exchange: Main Mode, SHA384 as Phase1 authentication algorithm and SHA512 as Phase 2 authentication algorithm. 6) On Peer FW, add the matched TI VPN policy. 7) Run VPN traffic. 8) Change Exchange mode to Aggressive Mode on local FW and peer FW, Run VPN traffic. 9) Change Exchange mode to IKEv2 Mode on local FW and peer FW, Run VPN traffic. 10) Repeat steps 5-9 for 3rd Authentication Method.
